annotation.title_clean: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.title_en: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tsujita, T.; Sakuma, Y.; Yamada, S.; Eto, R.; Kurosaki, M.
annotation.venue: Journal of the Robotics Society of Japan
annotation.summary_en: Short journal paper proposing an operation regulation framework for sentry robots under International Humanitarian Law, interpreting Additional Protocol I articles and computing legal indicators (certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage) for distinction, proportionality and precaution, validated with a real robot using terahertz imaging and LiDAR.
key_provisions_or_claims: Interprets Additional Protocol I articles (48, 51, 57) into requirements for robotic systems.
Proposes legal indicators: certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage.
Maps indicators to the principles of distinction, proportionality and precaution.
Keeps a human in the loop for decisions in the framework.
Validates the framework experimentally with a sentry robot detecting suicide-bomb threats.
